final_answer.key_evidence_summary: adservice pod adservice-645c94d6-9jrbk shows RESTARTS 2 (29s ago) within 91s while all other 10 boutique services show 0. Pod detail gives Last State: Terminated, Reason: Error, Exit Code 143 (kubelet SIGTERM), ruling out OOMKilled 137. Pod events name the mechanism verbatim: kubelet 'Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' and Warning Unhealthy 'Liveness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service "172.20.1.125:8080" within 1s: context deadline exceeded' (x8). Deployment YAML confirms the misconfiguration: livenessProbe.grpc.port=8080 while containerPort=9555, env PORT=9555, readinessProbe grpc port 9555 and Service targetPort 9555 all use 9555. GetRecentLogs(adservice) shows only INFO lines ending with 'Ad Service started, listening on 9555' with no errors, so the application itself is healthy and the restart loop is caused solely by the liveness probe targeting the wrong port.
